lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity nodes concentrated along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent linear ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and lower-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two elongated, dark-pigmented organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
